result.summary: Several layout and content issues: category chips and restaurant cards are clipped, a pizza card shows a placeholder “-0%” discount, and the last restaurant name is truncated.

issues.description: The last category chip (“Healthy”) is cut off on the right, so the horizontal category list looks incomplete and may hide more options.
issues.suggestion: Add peek/fade, padding, or a scroll indicator so chips aren’t clipped at the screen edge.

issues.description: The third “Fastest near you” card (Trattoria Piccol…) is clipped on the right and the restaurant name is truncated.
issues.suggestion: Give cards consistent width/spacing or allow wrapping so names and cards aren’t cut off.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a “-0%” badge, which looks like a broken or empty discount.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the value is 0% or show a real offer.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is cut off by the tab bar, so the restaurant name and details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area spacing so content isn’t hidden behind the tab bar.

issues.description: The last visible category chip on the right is only a partial circle, which looks unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the last chip is fully visible or use a clearer overflow treatment.
